safe_area.reason: A fixed or overlaid navigation bar sits across the top of the hero on most templates, and the lower edge is where the fold falls on common laptop viewports. Load-bearing content is kept clear of both so it survives the header and the fold.

structural_rules.focal_requirement: One proposition and one action above the fold. The hero is read at arm's length and has a moment to state what the page is for before the visitor scrolls or leaves.
